           function esc(s) { return $('<div>').text(s == null ? '' : s).html(); }\n\n            function posVarFromCode(code) {\n                switch ((code || '').toUpperCase()) {\n                    case 'GK': return 'gk';\n                    case 'DEF': /* ===================== Budget / cart computation ===================== */\n            function sumValues(obj) {\n                var total = 0;\n                $.each(obj, function (_, v) { total += v.value; });\n                return total;\n            }\n\n            function openSlotsByPos() {\n                // sells NOT yet filled by a buy, grouped by posVar\n                var open = { gk: 0, def: 0, mid: 0, fwd: 0 };\n                $.each(sells, function (_, s) {\n                    if (!s.filledBy) { open[s.posVar] = (open[s.posVar] || 0) + 1; }\n                });\n                return open;\n            }\n\n            function recompute() {\n                var outCount = Object.keys(sells).length;\n                var inCount = Object.keys(buys).length;\n                var budgetAfter = baseBudget + sumValues(sells) - sumValues(buys);\n\n                $cartOut.text(outCount);\n                $cartIn.text(inCount);\n                $cartBudget.text(fmtMoney(budgetAfter)).toggleClass('is-negative', budgetAfter < 0);\n                $budgetDisplay.text(fmtMoney(budgetAfter)).toggleClass('is-negative', budgetAfter < 0);\n\n                var open = openSlotsByPos();\n                var openTotal = open.gk + open.def + open.mid + open.fwd;\n\n                var hasTransfers = (outCount + inCount) > 0;\n                var {\n                    var parts = [];\n                    $.each(open, function (k, n) { if (n > 0) { parts.push(n + '+Œ ' + POS_LABEL[k]); } });\n                    msg = 'Popuni prazna mjesta: ' + parts.join(', ') + '.';\n                    tone = 'warn';\n                } else if (!budgetOk) {\n                    msg = 'Nedovoljno budgeta ÔÇö nedostaje ' + fmtMoney(-budgetAfter) + '.';\n                    tone = 'danger';\n                } else {\n                    msg = 'Spremno za potvrdu: ' + outCount + ' OUT, ' + inCount + ' IN.';\n                    tone = 'ok';\n                }\n                $cartHintText.text(msg);\n                $cartHint.attr('data-tone', tone);\n            }\n\n            /* ===================== Toast ===================== */\n            var $toast = $('[data-role=\"toast\"]');\n            var $toastText = $('[data-role=\"toast-text\"]');\n            var toastTimer = null;\n            function showToast(text) {\n                $toastText.text(text);\n                $toast.attr('aria-hidden', 'false').addClass('is-shown');\n                clearTimeout(toastTimer);\n                toastTimer = setTimeout(function () {\n                    $toast.removeClass('is-shown');\n                    setTimeout(function () { $toast.attr('aria-hidden', 'true'); }, 250);\n                }, 2600);\n            }\n\n            /* scored by a goalkeeper | 10 |\n| Goal scored by a defender | 6 |\n| Goal scored by a midfielder | 5 |\n| Goal scored by a forward | 4 |\n| Assist | 3 |\n| Clean sheet by a goalkeeper or defender | 4 |\n| Clean sheet by a midfielder | 1 |\n| Every 3 shot saves by a goalkeeper | 1 |\n| Penalty save | 5 |\n| Penalty miss | -2 |\n| Every 2 goals conceded by a goalkeeper or defender | -1 |\n| Yellow card | -1 |\n| Red card | -3 |\n| Own goal | -2 |\n| Bonus points (best performers in a match) | 1ÔÇô3 |\n\n## Defensive Contribution\n\nOutfield players can earn points for defensive actions across a match:\n\n| Position | Threshold | Points |\n|---|---|---|\n| Defender | 10+ clearances, blocks, interceptions and tackles (CBIT) | 2 |\n| Midfielder / Forward | 12+ clearances, blocks, interceptions, tackles and ball recoveries | 2 |\n\nThese points are awarded once per match when the threshold is reached.\n\n## Clean Sheets\n\n- A **clean sheet** is awarded for not conceding a goal while on the pitch, and only counts if the player has played **at least 60 minutes** (excluding stoppage time).\n- If a player is substituted before the team concedes, the clean sheet still stands for that player (provided 60+ minutes were played).\n- **Goalkeepers** and **defenders**: 4 points.\n- **Midfielders**: 1 point.\n- **Forwards**: no clean sheet points.\n\n## Goals Conceded\n\n- Goalkeepers and defenders lose **1 point for every 2 goals** their team concedes while they are on the pitch.\n\n## Saves\n\n- Goalkeepers earn **1 point for every 3 saves** they make in a match.\n\n## Assists\n\n- An assist is awarded to the player from the team scoring a goal who makes the **final touch** (pass, shot, or any other intentional contribution) before a teammate scores.\n- An assist is worth **3 points** for all positions.\n\n## Bonus Points (BPS ÔÇô Bonus Points System)\n\nThe three best-performing players in each match are awarded bonus points based on a separate **Bonus Points System (BPS)** that uses a range of statistics to create a score:\n\n- Highest BPS in a match: **3 bonus points**\n- Second highest: **2 bonus points**\n- Third highest: **1 bonus point**\n\nIf two or more players tie, bonus points are shared (e.g. two players tied for the top score each receive 3 points, and the next player receives 1).\n\n### Example BPS factors\n\nThe BPS rewards positive actions (and penalises negative ones), including:\n\n- Playing 1 to 60 minutes / over 60 minutes\n- Goals scored (weighted by position)\n- Assists\n- Goal-line clearances, blocks, interceptions, tackles and recoveries\n- Successful dribbles, key passes, big chances created\n- Saves and penalty saves\n- Errors leading to a goal, missed big chances, goals conceded\n- Yellow/red cards, own goals, penalties missed\n\n## Captaincy\n\n- The **captain's** points are **doubled** (+Œ2).\n- If the captain does not play in the gameweek, the **vice-captain** becomes the captain and their points are doubled instead.\n\n## Final Notes\n\n- A player's total points are the sum of all the actions above for each gameweek.\n- Points are provisional during live matches and are finalised (including bonus points) once the gameweek's data is confirmed.\n\n---\n\n*This file documents the FPL points scoring system. They are built in\n`Repositories/GameweekMockRepository.cs` and seeded by `DAL/DbSeeder.cs`; every\n`MatchPerformance.PointsEarned` value is baked in by hand, and player/team\npoints are static. There is no way to \"play\" a season.\n\nThe user wants the Gameweeks tab to become a **simulation engine**:\n\n- Delete the 6 seeded gameweeks and reset all accumulated points/stats to 0.\n- Two sub-tabs: **Simulate** (admin only) and **Preview** (everyone).\n- **Simulate** generates the next gameweek (GW1, then GW2, ÔÇŽ sequentially):\n  randomly pairs the 20 clubs into **10 fixtures**, rolls random scorelines,\n  attributes goals/assists/cards/etc. to individual players, and computes\n  fantasy points per `FPL-Scoring-Rules.md`. The result is saved and becomes\n  visible in **Preview** (the existing gameweek-statistics view).\n- Each user gets a **slider/arrows** in **My Team** to view their team's score\n  (and per-player points) for any past gameweek.\n\n**Decisions confirmed with the user:**\n1. **Reset all stats to 0** ÔÇö `Player.TotalPoints/Goals/Assists/CleanSheets`\n   and `FantasyTeam.TotalPoints` all start at 0 and rebuild from simulations.\n   Player **prices stay realistic** (decoupled from live points).\n2. **Skip captaincy** ÔÇö fantasy GW score = sum of the 11 starters' points.\n3. **Allow undo of the last gameweek** ÔÇö admin can delete the latest simulated\n   gameweek and have its points reversed (to re-roll a bad random result).\n\n> **UI rule (CLAUDE.md):** every `.cshtml`, CSS, and JS change below MUST be\n> implemented by the `ux-designer` subagent (Dark Stadium theme, custom CSS in\n> `wwwroot/css/site.css`, no default Bootstrap look). This plan describes *what*\n> the UI needs; the ux-designer builds it.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Data model changes\n\n### New entity `Models/Fixture.cs`\nOne row per simulated match (10 per gameweek) so Preview can show scorelines.\n```\nId, GameweekId (FK), HomeClub (string), AwayClub (string),\nHomeGoals (int), AwayGoals (int)\n```\n\n### New entity `Models/GameweekTeamScore.cs`\nSnapshot of each fantasy team's result for a gameweek ÔÇö the authoritative\n\"score you banked\", used by the My Team slider and by undo.\n```\nId, FantasyTeamId (FK), GameweekId (FK), Points (int),\nLineupIds (string?, snapshot of the 11 starter IDs at sim time)\n```\n\n### Extend `Models/MatchPerformance.cs`\nAdd fields needed for full FPL scoring + richer Preview stats:\n```\nint Saves;          // GK saves\nint GoalsConceded;  // = opponent goals (for GK/DEF conceded penalty)\nint Bonus;          // 0ÔÇô3 simplified bonus\n```\n(`CleanSheet`, `Goals`, `Assists`, `YellowCards`, `RedCards`, `MinutesPlayed`,\n`PointsEarned` already exist.)\n\n### `DAL/FantasyFootballDbContext.cs`\n- Add `DbSet<Fixture> Fixtures` and `DbSet<GameweekTeamScore> GameweekTeamScores`.\n- `Gameweek 1ÔÇôN Fixture`: **Cascade** (so undo/delete-gameweek removes fixtures).\n- `GameweekTeamScore`: FK to `Gameweek` = **Cascade**, FK to `FantasyTeam` =\n  **Restrict/NoAction** ÔÇö mirrors the existing `MatchPerformance` convention\n  (Gameweek=Cascade, Player=Restrict) and avoids SQL Server multiple-cascade-path\n  errors. (The `FantasyTeam` delete action must therefore clear that team's\n  `GameweekTeamScores` first ÔÇö see Tž6 note.)\n\n### EF migration (use the `entity-framework` skill)\nA single migration that does **schema + one-time data reset**. The data reset is\nessential because `DbSeeder` only full-seeds an *empty* DB ÔÇö an already-seeded\ndatabase must be reset here via `migrationBuilder.Sql(...)`:\n- Create `Fixtures`, `GameweekTeamScores`; add `Saves`/`GoalsConceded`/`Bonus`.\n- `DELETE FROM MatchPerformances; DELETE FROM Gameweeks;`\n- `UPDATE Players SET TotalPoints=0, Goals=0, Assists=0, CleanSheets=0;`\n- `UPDATE FantasyTeams SET TotalPoints=0;`\n- **Do NOT touch `Players.MarketValue`** ÔÇö prices stay as already priced.\n\nRuns once via `ctx.Database.Migrate()` in `Program.cs` (no-op on a fresh DB).\n\n---\n\n## 2. Seeding / reset changes ÔÇö `DAL/DbSeeder.cs`\n\n- **Stop seeding gameweeks**: remove the `GameweekMockRepository` usage\n  (`gameweekRepo`, the `gameweeks` list, the id-reset loop at lines 56ÔÇô57, and\n  `context.Gameweeks.AddRange(gameweeks)` at line 83). Leave the\n  `GameweekMockRepository.cs` file in place so `GameweekApiController`/tests that\n  reference it still compile.\n- **Fresh-DB full seed**: after `ApplyPointBasedPrices(players)` (line 66) ÔÇö which\n  must still run so prices are derived from the mock points ÔÇö zero the live\n  counters: `p.TotalPoints = p.Goals = p.Assists = p.CleanSheets = 0`. Also set\n  `t.TotalPoints = 0` in the team loop (lines 76ÔÇô77).\n- **Decouple price from live points**: in `RebalancePrices` (line 147) **remove\n  the `ApplyPointBasedPrices(players)` call** (line 152). Prices are now fixed at\n  seed time; recomputing them from accumulating live points would distort them.\n  Keep the squad-fill / constraint / budget logic.\n- **`EnsureAllMockPlayers`** (newly added clubs on an existing DB): price each new\n  player once from its own mock `TotalPoints` (reuse the MinPrice/MaxPrice\n  mapping), then zero its live counters ÔÇö since `RebalancePrices` no longer prices\n  them.\n\n`MinPrice`/`MaxPrice` constants and `ApplyPointBasedPrices` stay as the one-time\npricing source.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Simulation engine ÔÇö `Services/GameweekSimulationService.cs` (new)\n\nInjected with `FantasyFootballDbContext`; registered in `Program.cs` DI. Two\npublic methods.\n\n### `SimulateNextGameweekAsync()`\n1. `next = (max WeekNumber ?? 0) + 1`. If `next > 38`, throw/return \"season\n   complete\" (model caps at 38).\n2. Create `Gameweek { WeekNumber=next, StartDate, EndDate }` (synthetic dates,\n   e.g. base + (next-1)*7 days).\n3. Distinct clubs from `Players.Club` (20). **Shuffle**, pair into **10 fixtures**\n   (home/away). Create `Fixture` rows.\n4. Per fixture roll a **random scoreline** ÔÇö weighted toward low scores\n   (e.g. goals ~ {0:25%,1:30%,2:22%,3:13%,4:6%,5:3%,6:1%}). For each side:\n   `conceded = other side's goals`, `cleanSheetEligible = conceded == 0`.\n5. Per club, pick a **starting XI** from its 15 players (1 GK + 4 DEF + 4 MID + 2\n   FWD). Assign minutes (most 90; a couple 45ÔÇô70). Distribute that club's goals to\n   scorers weighted FWD>MID>DEF>GK; ~60% of goals also give an **assist** to a\n   different teammate. Random cards (yellow ~12%, red ~1.5%). GK `Saves` random\n   (more when conceding more). Set `GoalsConceded` on GK+DEF; set `CleanSheet =\n   (conceded==0 \u0026\u0026 minutes>=60)`.\n6. Compute `PointsEarned` per **FPL rules** (see Tž3a). Create `MatchPerformance`\n   rows (set `Opponent`, `MatchDate`, `GameweekId`, `PlayerId`).\n7. **Bonus**: within each fixture rank performances by base points; award +3/+2/+1\n   to the top three (stored in `Bonus`, included in `PointsEarned`).\n8. Aggregate onto players: `Player.TotalPoints += pts`, `Goals += goals`,\n   `Assists += assists`, `CleanSheets += (cleanSheet?1:0)`.\n9. Per `FantasyTeam`: read current `StartingLineupIds` (or default XI), sum its\n   11 starters' `PointsEarned` this GW Ôæå create `GameweekTeamScore` (with\n   `LineupIds` snapshot) and `FantasyTeam.TotalPoints += that`.\n10. `SaveChanges`.\n\n### `UndoLastGameweekAsync()`\n- Load latest gameweek (`Include(Performances)`) + its `GameweekTeamScores`.\n- Subtract each performance from `Player.TotalPoints/Goals/Assists/CleanSheets`.\n- Subtract each `GameweekTeamScore.Points` from `FantasyTeam.TotalPoints`.\n- `Remove(gameweek)` (cascade removes Performances, Fixtures, GameweekTeamScores);\n  `SaveChanges`.\n\n### Tž3a FPL scoring (from `FPL-Scoring-Rules.md`)\nPer performance (`pos`, `min`, `gc`, `saves`):\n- Appearance: `min>=60 Ôæå +2`, `1ÔÇô59 Ôæå +1`, `0 Ôæå 0`.\n- Goals +Œ {GK 10, DEF 6, MID 5, FWD 4}; Assists +Œ 3.\n- Clean sheet (only if `min>=60 \u0026\u0026 gc==0`): GK/DEF +4, MID +1, FWD 0.\n- Saves (GK): `+ floor(saves/3)`. Conceded (GK/DEF): `- floor(gc/2)`.\n- Yellow Ô³å1 each; Red Ô³å3 each. Bonus +0..3.\n- (Penalty save/miss \u0026 own goals **omitted** for simplicity ÔÇö note in code.)\n`PointsEarned` may be negative (valid in FPL).\n\n---\n\n## 4. Gameweek controller \u0026 sub-tabs ÔÇö `Controllers/GameweekController.cs`\n\n- **Remove** `Create` (GET/POST), `Edit` (GET/POST), `Delete` (GET/POST) actions\n  and **delete** `Views/Gameweek/Create.cshtml`, `Edit.cshtml`, `Delete.cshtml`.\n  (`GameweekFormViewModel` becomes unused ÔÇö leave or delete.) The `Api/\n  GameweekApiController` is left intact (backward-compat / existing tests).\n- Keep **`Index`** (`/kola`) = **Preview** list and **`Details`** (`/kolo/{id}`) =\n  Preview detail. Ensure `Details` loads `Fixtures` (via `GameweekRepository` or\n  `_ctx`) so the 10 scorelines render.\n- Inject `GameweekSimulationService`. Add:\n  - **`Simulate` (GET, `[Authorize(Roles=AdminRole)]`)** Ôæå `SimulateGameweekViewModel`\n    { `NextWeekNumber`, `SimulatedGameweeks` list, `SeasonComplete` (next>38) }.\n  - **`Simulate` (POST, admin, antiforgery)** Ôæå `SimulateNextGameweekAsync()`,\n    `TempData` success, redirect to `Details` of the new gameweek (Preview).\n  - **`UndoLastGameweek` (POST, admin, antiforgery)** Ôæå `UndoLastGameweekAsync()`,\n    redirect to `Simulate`.\n\n### Sub-tab nav ÔÇö `Views/Shared/_GameweekTabs.cshtml` (new, ux-designer)\nReusable partial rendering **Preview** (always) and **Simulate** (only\n`User.IsInRole(\"Admin\")`), with active-state styling, included at the top of\n`Index`, `Details`, and `Simulate`. New CSS in `site.css` (themed pill/tab bar ÔÇö\nthe app has no existing sub-tab pattern).\n\n### `Views/Gameweek/Simulate.cshtml` (new, ux-designer)\nAdmin control panel: \"Next gameweek to simulate: **GW{n}**\" + primary\n**Simulate Gameweek {n}** button (POST form); list of already-simulated\ngameweeks linking to Preview; **Undo last gameweek** button (POST, confirm);\n\"Season complete\" state when n>38.\n\n### `Views/Gameweek/Index.cshtml` (Preview, ux-designer)\nRemove the admin \"Kreiraj kolo\" action bar and the per-card Edit/Delete buttons\n(lines 16ÔÇô27, 82ÔÇô94). Add the `_GameweekTabs` bar. Show friendly empty state\n(\"No gameweeks simulated yet\") until GW1.\n\n### `Views/Gameweek/Details.cshtml` (Preview, ux-designer)\nAdd the `_GameweekTabs` bar; add a **Fixtures** section listing the 10 scorelines\n(HomeClub HÔÇôA AwayClub); add `Saves` / `Conceded` / `Bonus` columns to the\nperformances table.\n\n---\n\n## 5. My Team gameweek slider\n\n### `Controllers/FantasyTeamController.cs` ÔÇö `MyTeam(int? gw = null)`\n- Load all simulated gameweeks (number+id) for the slider.\n- If `gw` set: load `MatchPerformances` for the squad's players in that gameweek\n  Ôæå `Dictionary<playerId,int>` of GW points; load the team's\n  `GameweekTeamScore` for that GW Ôæå headline team score.\n- Pass these into `BuildMyTeamViewModel`.\n\n### `Models/ViewModels/MyTeamViewModel.cs`\nAdd: `List<(int Number,int Id)> Gameweeks`, `int? SelectedGameweek`,\n`int? GameweekTeamPoints`, `Dictionary<int,int> PlayerGameweekPoints`,\n`int SeasonTotalPoints`.\n\n### `Views/FantasyTeam/MyTeam.cshtml` + `_PitchPlayer.cshtml` (ux-designer)\n- Add a slider / ÔŒÇ Ô¾Â arrow control above the pitch: positions = **Season**\n  (default) + GW1ÔÇŽGWn. Themed, keyboard-accessible, ARIA-labelled.\n- Default (Season): shirts show `TotalPoints`, header shows season total.\n- A gameweek selected: shirts show that player's **GW points**\n  (`PlayerGameweekPoints`, 0 if they didn't feature) and a prominent header shows\n  **\"Gameweek N: {GameweekTeamPoints} pts\"** (the authoritative snapshot score).\n- `_PitchPlayer.cshtml` gains an optional GW-points mode via `ViewData` (falls\n  back to `TotalPoints`).\n- Simplest robust approach: keep the **current** squad on the pitch; the headline\n  uses the stored snapshot. Note in code that, after transfers, the per-shirt\n  overlay (current squad) may not sum exactly to the banked headline ÔÇö expected.\n\n---\n\n## 6. TOTW/Player-of-the-Week populate from simulated data after\n  GW1.\n- **FantasyTeam delete path**: because `GameweekTeamScoreÔæåFantasyTeam` is\n  Restrict, ensure team deletion removes its `GameweekTeamScores` first (add to\n  the existing delete action) to avoid an FK error.\n- **`GameweekRepository`**: confirm `GetById` includes `Fixtures` for Details.\n\n### Files at a glance\n**New:** `Models/Fixture.cs`, `Models/GameweekTeamScore.cs`,\n`Services/GameweekSimulationService.cs`,\n`Models/ViewModels/SimulateGameweekViewModel.cs`,\n`Views/Gameweek/Simulate.cshtml`, `Views/Shared/_GameweekTabs.cshtml`,\n+ 1 EF migration.\n**Modified:** `Models/MatchPerformance.cs`, `Models/ViewModels/MyTeamViewModel.cs`,\n`DAL/FantasyFootballDbContext.cs`, `DAL/DbSeeder.cs`,\n`Controllers/GameweekController.cs`, `Controllers/FantasyTeamController.cs`,\n`Views/Gameweek/Index.cshtml`, `Views/Gameweek/Details.cshtml`,\n`Views/FantasyTeam/MyTeam.cshtml`, `Views/Shared/_PitchPlayer.cshtml`,\n`Program.cs`, `wwwroot/css/site.css`, `wwwroot/js/site.js`.\n**Deleted:** `Views/Gameweek/Create.cshtml`, `Edit.cshtml`, `Delete.cshtml`.\n\n---\n\n## 7.      else if (p.MinutesPlayed >= 1) pts += 1;\n\n            int goalPts = p.Position switch\n            {\n                Position.Goalkeeper => 10,\n                Position.Defender => 6,\n
